criterion: ROADMAP P14 stage 1 (2026-10-22): the volumetric cloud and smoke module on the CPU, with its references, goldens and the review of the fuzzy-blob failure. Stage 2 is the GPU pass with parity, blue-noise jitter and temporal reprojection.
written: 2026-10-22, before any code and before any run

design.density: raw/renderer/volume.hpp: a union of soft-sphere lobes (each a smooth falloff to its radius), under a height gradient that makes a flat base and lets the lobes round the top, eroded by P8's Worley F1 (cauliflower edges) and billow noise (wisps); a density scale (extinction per metre) and a single-scattering albedo. One module: cumulus, towering cumulus, a deck seen from above, and a smoke plume (lobes rising and widening, lower albedo).
design.raymarcher: the engine's look, float64: fixed steps along the camera ray, Beer transmittance to the sun by a secondary march, a dual-lobe Henyey-Greenstein phase (forward and back lobes mixed) for the silver lining, an optional Beer-powder term for darkened edges (an artistic term that does not conserve energy; off for the reference checks), ambient from the sky, and an optional multiple-scattering approximation by octaves (attenuated extinction, contrast and eccentricity per octave, after Wrenninge). The sky is sky::preetham (P11), the sun its directional light.
design.reference: a brute-force volumetric path tracer of the same density: delta tracking against a majorant, next-event estimation to the sun with ratio tracking, phase-function sampling, in single-scattering and multiple-scattering modes, the environment on escape. Float64, independent of the raymarcher's steps.

v1_furnace.what: albedo 1, a uniform environment of radiance 1, no sun, the path tracer in multiple-scattering mode, pixels inside and outside a dense cloud
v1_furnace.bound: mean radiance within 4 standard errors + 2e-3 of 1
v1_furnace.prediction: holds; the control (albedo 0.5) falls well below 1

v2_single_scattering.what: the raymarcher (powder off, ambient off, one octave) against the path tracer in single-scattering mode (sun only), a single cumulus at 48 x 27
v2_single_scattering.bound: image mean within 3% and relative RMSE of 8 x 8 blocks at most 0.1 at the path tracer's noise level
v2_single_scattering.prediction: holds at a step of 1/16 of the lobe radius; a coarse-step control (1/2 of the radius) misses

v3_goldens.what: tests/test_clouds.cpp: single cumulus, towering cumulus, deck from above and smoke plume at sunset, 96 x 54, hashed per compiler family

v4_multiple.what: the raymarcher's octave approximation against the path tracer's multiple scattering on the single cumulus

v5_blob_review.what: the lobe-built cumulus against a control built from fBm alone with the same mean density: mean alpha-gradient magnitude in the band around the silhouette; and the two images side by side, viewed
v5_blob_review.bound: the lobe cloud's edge gradient at least 1.5 times the noise blob's; the review judged by eye and recorded
v5_blob_review.prediction: holds; the noise blob reads as fog

does_not_prove: Real-time rates or GPU parity (stage 2); agreement with a measured cloud; that the artistic terms (powder, octaves) are physical.
